author: Bar Winkler
title: Wonderful Asia-Pacific
bodyHtml:
Wonderful is opening its first offices across Asia-Pacific, bringing the next generation of AI agents to a region defined by ambition, reinvention, and some of the world's most dynamic digital economies.

The landscape of Asia-Pacific presents a unique complexity shaped by powerful contrasts and extraordinary market diversity. Regulatory approaches vary significantly from one border to the next, while cultural and linguistic depth fundamentally influences how trust is built and how business gets done. Success in this region demands more than a global playbook; it requires genuine local understanding.

That complexity is precisely what makes the region so compelling. APAC is home to some of the world's most sophisticated financial centers, leading technology ecosystems, and fastest-growing economies. Mature enterprise markets sit alongside mobile-first economies that are rewriting the rules of digital adoption. And yet, beneath that diversity lies a common thread: every market has its own pace, its own priorities, and its own definition of what AI transformation looks like in practice.

Our launch in Asia-Pacific is a major step in bringing enterprise-ready AI to a region with immense demand. It reflects our commitment to building technology that adapts to local languages, regulations, and business realities, ensuring that enterprises across APAC can truly transform their operating model with AI to streamline operations and deliver world-class service at scale.

"APAC represents a diverse array of languages, cultures, and business practices. We are excited to bring Wonderful's platform, which has already been tested, refined, and improved in production across multiple verticals and geographies, to a region where depth of experience is non-negotiable, and where agentic AI represents the most exciting paradigm shift of our generation."

Henek Lo, Managing Director, Asia-Pacific

Wonderful is already partnering with forward-thinking enterprises in the region, and these partnerships show what becomes possible when AI is grounded in local knowledge and delivered with global execution standards, supporting high-impact workflows across customer care, collections, back-office operations, and sales.

We've built a team on the ground and continue to hire Deployment Strategists, Forward Deployed Engineers, and Strategic Account Managers across Hong Kong, Singapore, Japan, South Korea, Australia and New Zealand, Thailand, Indonesia, and Vietnam. If you're interested in joining us and shaping the future of enterprise AI in Asia-Pacific, explore our Careers page and reach out, we'd love to hear from you.
